Markets.title: Alcohol stocks jump as blue wave boosts industry prospects
Markets.summary: Alcohol stocks rose during the midterm elections as investors anticipated favorable immigration policies and easing trade tensions with Canada. However, looming tariffs continued to cause a sharp decline in U.S. spirits exports.

Markets.title: Musk stocks lose $120 billion as Democrats’ Texas win rattles investors
Markets.summary: Tesla and SpaceX lost a combined $120 billion in market value following major Democratic election victories, including a key win in Texas. Investors fear that a Democratic-controlled Congress will increase regulatory scrutiny on Elon Musk's businesses and potentially complicate a Tesla-SpaceX merger.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rebounds with stocks despite threat to crypto agenda
Markets.summary: Bitcoin rose over 4% to surpass $81,000, following a broader market recovery after the US midterm elections. However, Democratic control of Congress could stall crypto-friendly laws and increase regulatory oversight.

Markets.title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections
Markets.summary: After Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterms, AI data center stocks fell due to fears of tighter oversight. Meanwhile, renewable energy shares surged as investors anticipated continued government support for clean energy.

Markets.title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
Markets.summary: The US Treasury updated its regulations, signaling potential increases in short- and intermediate-term debt issuance. Future auction sizes will depend on demand trends and financial requirements, with the Treasury noting a likely decrease in demand for 20- and 30-year bonds.

Markets.title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
Markets.summary: Meta Platforms received a record €53 billion in investor orders for its debut euro bond sale. The company aims to raise €9 billion across six parts, following a recent $15 billion US bond offering.

Geo-Political.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
Geo-Political.summary: Angry Republicans blamed Donald Trump for their defeat in the midterm elections. They stated that his focus on his own legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost the party the election.

Geo-Political.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
Geo-Political.summary: The U.S. midterm election results create pressure on the White House to reach a trade deal with Canada. This political shift brings renewed hope to Canadians seeking relief from U.S. tariffs as bilateral trade talks resume.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv reports that a Russian double-tap bombing in a Ukrainian village killed at least 40 people on Monday. Another 30 people may still be trapped beneath the rubble, according to Ukrainian officials.

Geo-Political.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
Geo-Political.summary: Hackers targeted the cold rooms of the French Blood Establishment, disrupting the storage of blood products. Authorities are currently investigating the cyberattack to determine who is responsible.

Geo-Political.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
Geo-Political.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono issued a statement expressing profound sorrow following the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel. Owono described the aftermath of the incident as the most difficult days of his life.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has begun holding consultations with political parties following the country's recent election deadlock. He warned politicians that they must be willing to compromise on their promises in order to avoid triggering yet another election.

Data & Insights.title: Trump's midterm setback may give India an edge in trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: Despite the Republican midterm defeat, the US embassy stated that trade talks with India remain on track. An American spokesperson emphasized that President Donald Trump continues to direct Washington's trade agenda.

Data & Insights.title: Explained: Why could a weak monsoon derail India's ambitious ethanol blending programme?
Data & Insights.summary: India's weak monsoon and rising food prices are prioritizing food security over ethanol production. This shift could cause India to miss its 20% fuel-blending target and increase its reliance on imported crude oil.

Data & Insights.title: LTCG tax relief on cards? FM acknowledges FPI concerns as SEBI, FICCI push for reforms in Budget 2027
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman acknowledged rising foreign investment outflows and investor concerns regarding India's market climate. She stated the government will review this feedback to help sustain economic growth near 7%.

Data & Insights.title: India sees some trade relief, new risks after US midterm vote
Data & Insights.summary: Following the US midterm elections, political pressure on the Trump administration has eased, giving New Delhi more breathing room in trade negotiations. This outcome reduces India's urgency to accept terms it currently considers unfavorable, though it introduces new risks.

Data & Insights.title: Services sector growth hits a four-month peak in October, PMI survey shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's services sector growth reached a four-month high in October, with the HSBC PMI rising to 55.8 due to strong domestic demand. This expansion occurred even as export orders and hiring slowed and cost pressures dropped to a six-year low.

Data & Insights.title: Geographical branding revolutionized French champagne; are GI tags working for India, too?
Data & Insights.summary: India is increasingly granting Geographical Indication tags to its many region-specific products to boost their branding. While some of these regional labeling efforts have achieved success, others still need to unlock their full economic potential.

India.title: Vijay Says Meeting With School Toppers In Chennai Not About Politics
India.summary: Actor Vijay stated that his meeting with school toppers in Chennai was not political. The event followed Madras High Court criticism regarding the involvement of children in his party's campaigns.

India.title: How US Polls Can Change The World For Trump: Foreign Policy Editor Explains
India.summary: Foreign Policy Editor Ravi Agrawal explains that global countries and companies will adapt their approach to a weakening Donald Trump. This shift in international perception could significantly change foreign policy outcomes for his administration.

India.title: "Could Smell Alcohol On Him": Rahul Gandhi Attacks Bhagwant Mann, AAP Reacts
India.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann by alleging he smelled of alcohol and lacked commitment to solving the state's drug crisis. The Aam Aadmi Party reacted to the remarks, defending their leadership against the accusations.

India.title: Man Accuses Wife, Mother-In-Law Of Forced Circumcision In Assam
India.summary: An Assam man named Akhil Kumar Chandak has filed a police report accusing his wife and mother-in-law of forcing him to undergo circumcision. The complaint was lodged against 24-year-old Nurshika Begum and 36-year-old Nur Khatun at the Bhangagarh Police Station.

India.title: 4 Militants Killed As Rival Groups Clash In Manipur Village
India.summary: Four militants died during a clash between rival armed groups in a Manipur village on Wednesday. Police sources identified three deceased members as belonging to the Zeliangrong United Front and one as a member of the National Socialist Council of Nagalim.

India.title: 6 Arrested by Assam Police In Fraud Case, Pak Link Under Scanner
India.summary: Assam Police arrested six people in connection with a fraud case involving a suspected cross-border financial syndicate. The Special Task Force initiated the crackdown after receiving intelligence inputs regarding potential links to Pakistan.

General.title: Bowen: Trump's loss limits powers at home, but it will likely be different abroad
General.summary: Following his midterm election losses, US President Trump's domestic authority will be restricted. However, he is expected to remain assertive and continue attempting to shake the world in international affairs.
